components.text: Razor Edges increases the damage of throwables, such as a trident.

components.lore:
The points are sharpened with enviable precision. Only a select group of weapons can withstand being enchanted with such power.

Throwable weapons retain this property when thrown.

components.text: it can be obtained from the loot of the monuments
